_comment: Real CI runs that shaped the suite (GitHub Actions, RaktimChandra/cypress-kitchen-sink-testing). Numbers copied from results-<browser>.json of each run.

runs.label: Run 1 · first execution
runs.note: Known-defect cases were counted as passes because the metadata catalogue was empty (harness bug, fixed in run 2).

triage.examples: 22 axe page audits → DEF-KS-010…013; TC-TD-132 → DEF-KS-009 duplicate ids; TC-NAV-080 → DEF-KS-014

triage.category: Wrong test oracle or setup (test fixed)
triage.examples: 8 XSS cases typed a literal {enter}; selectors; Cypress 16 error text; reserved alias 'slow'; R1 don't-care; focus before realType
type=email re-sanitised per key (2); autofocus suppressed in the runner iframe; CORS on a rewritten response; Firefox keeps '1e2'

mutation.label: Mutation run 1
mutation.survivors: M27 (Clear completed rendered when 0 done), M31 (disabled radio)

triage_note: 44 distinct failing cases in run 1 (43 in Chromium browsers + TC-FC-152 in Firefox only). Three harness bugs were found and fixed alongside: catalogue lost across bundles, browser name unknown in plugins, axe evidence written after the assertion.
